: Explore the fascinating world of geology and paleontology with this comprehensive rock, mineral, and fossil collection set, perfect for collectors or educational use. The collection includes a sturdy plastic organizer box with red segmented trays, holding an impressive array of specimens. Visible varieties include rose quartz, citrine, amethyst, sodalite, aventurine, polished stones, and more.
Additionally, the set features 10 individually bagged fossils, such as trilobite, dinosaur bone, ammonite, brachiopod, petrified wood, shark tooth, coral, and other clearly labeled specimens, each with informational inserts describing their origins. This diverse assortment allows for hands-on study and display, making it ideal for beginners, hobbyists, classrooms, and anyone interested in earth science. The overall condition appears gently used, with all contents securely housed and ready for immediate use or gifting.
